map.📚 深度解析：测量系统能力 Cg: 📚 Deep Dive: Measurement system capability Cg
map.Cg = (USL-LSL)/(6*sigma_measure)（或 0.2*(: Cg = (USL-LSL)/(6*sigma_measure) (or the constrained form 0.2*(USL-LSL)). Example: tolerance 0.1, sigma_m=0.008 gives Cg = 0.1/(6*0.008) = 2.08.
map.Cg=(8−2)/(6×0.25)=4.000，远高于 1.33 的门槛，说明量: Cg = (8-2)/(6 x 0.25) = 4.000, far above the 1.33 threshold, so the gage resolution is more than enough for this tolerance zone.
